whoami.title: WHO AM I?
whoami.p1: Hi! I'm Alberto Plaza Montes, a Computer Science Engineer (M.Sc.) based in Spain.
whoami.p2: I work in the FinTech sector as a Backend Software Engineer, specializing in designing event-driven architectures (DDD), transactional systems, and high-performance services.
whoami.p3: Outside of work, I maintain my own homelab and build projects focused on distributed systems, concurrency, and FinTech infrastructure.
whoami.p4: I focus on building resilient, scalable software with strict data integrity, adhering to industry standards such as EBA and BIAN.
philosophy.header.title: ENGINEERING PHILOSOPHY
philosophy.header.subtitle: Technical principles and engineering mindset that drive how I design, build, and scale systems.
philosophy.p1.title: Empirical measurement before optimization
philosophy.p1.stance: Zero changes based on guesswork. Before altering code or introducing new tooling, I profile real bottlenecks (JVM, database contention, network latency).
philosophy.p1.proof: In practice: Virtual Threads refactoring delivering a 49.8% performance gain and direct SQL query optimization on Mapfre Afín.
philosophy.p2.title: Radical simplicity & low maintenance overhead
philosophy.p2.stance: The best architecture isn't the one with the most patterns, but the simplest one meeting all non-functional requirements. I favor clean, 3:00 AM-debuggable designs over superfluous abstraction layers.
philosophy.p2.proof: In practice: Contract-first API design (OpenAPI) and clean boundaries eliminating integration friction without ghost layers.
philosophy.p3.title: Data invariants & consistency over distributed complexity
philosophy.p3.stance: In FinTech, data integrity comes first. The priority is not accumulating microservices, but ensuring accurate balances, idempotent events, and zero corrupted states. If a SQL transaction solves it, skip the distributed complexity.
philosophy.p3.proof: In practice: Architecting reconciliation and transitory omnibus accounting systems ensuring 100% consistency.
philosophy.p4.title: Business impact & fast, safe delivery
philosophy.p4.stance: Software only provides value when running reliably in production. Automation (CI/CD, targeted testing) exists to shorten Time-to-Market safely, never for pure dogma.
philosophy.p4.proof: In practice: Robust pipelines and test suites enabling rapid iterations and safe deployments in highly regulated environments.
